Signature dishes

The plates Urban Kitchen is known for — chicken done several delicious ways, a comfort-food classic, warming soups and a sweet finish.

Signature

Cordon Chicken

Golden, crumbed chicken rolled around a melted cheese centre — crisp outside, rich and gooey inside.

Signature

Chicken Parmesan

Breaded chicken under a layer of tomato sauce and melted cheese — a continental classic, done properly.

Signature

Tuscan Polo Chicken

Tender chicken in a creamy Tuscan-style sauce — smooth, savoury and full of flavour in every bite.

A neighbourhood kitchen on Main Boulevard

Urban Kitchen sits at 95 D, Block D1, Main Boulevard, Gulberg III — right opposite Mall 1 (opposite Mocca), in one of Lahore's busiest dining districts.

The menu leans modern and continental: chicken signatures like the Cordon Chicken, Chicken Parmesan and Tuscan Polo Chicken, stuffed chicken with garlic rice, mac & cheese, soups to start and desserts — a brownie skillet and apple crumble tart — to finish.
